name: EXM_EXPENSE_PERDIEM_DESTS
description: This table contains expense per diem destinations.

columns.name: EXPENSE_PERDIEM_DEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a per diem expense detail.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Per diem expense item to which a per diem expense detail belongs.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of a per diem trip, which may include start time depending on type of policy.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of a per diem trip, which may include end time depending on type of policy.

columns.name: FROM_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Used to identify starting location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: FROM_ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code of a zone type for the starting location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Used to identify ending location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: TO_ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code of a zone type for the ending location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which the per diem rate is specified.

columns.name: NUM_OF_MEALS
columns.description: Number of meals used to calculate meals deduction or rate.

columns.name: TRAVEL_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of travel used during a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: ACCOM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of accommodation used during a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
